page.overview:
What is Ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra?

The ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra was a clash between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire that occurred at the Derra during the Empire's search for the rebel base after the Battle of Yavin. Although the ambush did not provide the Empire with the location of the base, it fit together with chatter about increased rebel operations in the region that had been tracked by Imperial Intelligence. Following the ambush, the Imperial search for the rebel base intensified. although it was true that she already had a connection to that vessel.

The ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra was mentioned within the canon source Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy. This Legends battle had previously been referenced in canon through Star Wars Helmet Collection 3 as an ambush on Red Squadron. However, no canon source has linked the ambush of a rebel convoy and the ambush on Red Squadron at this time.

More detail was provided about the battle in canon in the book Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire by Doctor Chris Kempshall, which is framed as an in-universe text by historian Beaumont Kin. According the book, the battle saw Rae Sloane promoted from the rank of Vice Admiral to a full admiral. and "Lord Vader Will See You Now" establish she was still a commodore in the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth, which occurs after the ambush. Further, the book alleges that Sloane was in command of the Vigilance during the battle, which she only received command of in the short story "Lord Vader Will See You Now." However, she did already have a history with the ship according to the video game Star Wars: Squadrons.
